gate-intro: The Gate Crab guards a secret shell rule. Test rows to find it, then sort five new rows to prove you know!
gate-help: Build a row of shells and tap Test at gate. Watch which rows pass and which rows block. When you think you know the secret rule, tap Take the quiz and sort five new rows. A wrong guess gives you a new clue.
gate-coach: Pick shells for the row, then tap Test at gate.
gate-pass: The gate opens! That row passes.
gate-block: The gate stays shut. That row blocks.
gate-already-tested: You already tested that row! Look for it in your clues.
gate-quiz-ready: Sort all five rows into Pass or Block, then tap Check my five.
gate-counterexample: Not quite yet! That row joins your clues so you can compare and test again.
gate-solved: You cracked the Gate Crab's secret rule!
gate-hint-look: Look at all the passing rows together. What do they share?
gate-hint-think: Try changing just one shell to test your guess.
gate-maker-cover: Hand the device to the rule maker. No peeking!
gate-guesser-cover: Secret rule locked! Hand the device to the tester.
gate-maker-locked: The secret rule is hidden and ready.
